dismissed.why: In this pack an anatomy part's required means the package always renders it (agent-pack/README.md, Decisions: false for an optional prop or slot). Attached's children is optional (children?: React.ReactNode, Attached.tsx line 35, 0.1.78-dbe0e02), and without it the main slot renders nothing (mainChildren is null, line 164), so the part is not always present. Every composition in the guide has a main item, and the entry keeps that as the part's role (“establishes the size and is the visual object people identify first”) and in all three examples; DropdownInput's and FormField's labels are recorded the same way.

dismissed.reason: misreads-source: The cited source says the guide uses "Icon Capsule Size modes M and XS", so the main child is explicitly size M. The description calls it "at its default size" and the code omits the M mode, which assumes M is the default. It also asserts a "default bottom-right anchor". The cited text supports neither claim.

dismissed.why: Both defaults are package facts, which the cross-check does not see: the entry’s position fact gives default "bottom-right" (Attached.tsx line 135), and IconCapsule’s Icon Capsule Size collection defaults to M (the package’s FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES; IconCapsule’s entry lists it). The guide sets M on the main capsule; the example leaves it out because the building rules say to leave modes at their defaults, and the purpose says so. The badge keeps XS, which the Sources sentence names.
